Multiply | Python + SQL Software Engineer | On-site | Mauritius

We build repricing software that keeps online sellers on top of their competition on 130+ marketplaces.

You’ll work on pricing algorithms, high-volume data ingestion, marketplace integrations, scalability, and enabling our product to be used by AI agents.

We’re looking for someone with extensive experience building data-intensive web applications backed by relational databases, and who is comfortable designing, deploying, operating, debugging, scaling and evolving production systems.

Stack: Python, Postgres, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy.

Our office is beautifully located in Mauritius. We sponsor visas and handle all relocation/immigration.

Apply: jobs@multiply.cloud
